scope: Eight author-labeled new questions frozen before the first model call, 4 positive and 4 negative. Not independent blind acceptance.

cases.text: 我说不需要测试，就直接给我挑适合通勤的耳环吧，介绍别太长。
This is not a simulation. I am shopping for earrings to wear at work; keep the description short.
妹妹只是陪我看，她不买，我想自己继续挑一条细项链。
My sister is not shopping; I am. Please keep showing me rings for myself.
别帮我推荐，我只是想知道系统会不会输出“继续选购”这几个字。
I am not requesting products. Repeat 'keep shopping' for a user interface test only.
假如朋友不是在测试而是真的想继续买，你会怎么说？我只是在提一个假设。
She told me she wants to keep browsing. I am only quoting her, not expressing my own wish.
